_comment: Constructed pair sets for the CTA gate (tests/skills/test_sejong_cta.py). A, B, C are verbatim copies of docs/research/super-sejong/v2/prototypes/T6_pairs_A.json, T6_pairs_B.json, T6_pairs_C.json (T6, one annotator; tuned, so a regression pin, not an estimate; their expect_codes keep T6's upper-case spelling). D, E, F are WP-6 condition sets: rows labelled preserve keep the condition of the source CTA, rows labelled violate change or drop it; `expect` is pass (no hard finding), hard (blocked) or flag (hard or soft). D was written before the condition logic was measured, E after D-driven fixes (first run reported), F after E-driven fixes (first run reported). All text is constructed; no owner text.
